title: drain.replies.json — drafted thread replies
description: The single artifact the drafting agent writes: one answer per pending thread, pinned to the plan digest. Verdict validates every site before any later step reads it; there is no host write in this build.

schema_version.description: Draft format version; only "1" is published.

plan_digest.description: The digest from drain.json the drafts were written against; a mismatch refuses drafts-stale.

replies.description: One draft per thread the agent chose to answer; pending threads with no entry are skipped no-draft.

reply.description: One disposition for one waiting comment, with the body that would be posted.

thread_id.description: Host thread id from the plan.

waiting_comment_id.description: The plan's waiting comment id; a changed comment refuses drafts-invalid.

disposition.description: answer posts the body, withdraw posts then resolves, defer posts nothing.

body.description: Reply text, required and non-empty for answer and withdraw; at most 4000 characters and never carrying verdict's markers.
